_comment: Example policy. Replace it with yours before you deploy. Every key here is optional; Claude Code merges this above user and project settings, and a user cannot override what it sets.

permissions._comment: Blocking bypass mode is the one setting most teams want first. It stops --dangerously-skip-permissions from turning every prompt off.

_env_comment: Environment variables forced on every session on this machine.
_claudeMd_comment: Text appended to each session's context, whatever the project. Keep it short; it costs tokens on every turn. With a claude-md/ directory beside this file, render-claude-md.sh writes this key from the Markdown in it.
_hooks_comment: Hooks defined here run for everyone and nobody can remove them. Point them at a root-owned script, never at a path inside a user's home, or the guarantee is only as strong as that file's permissions.
